focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，中企应提前布局供应链合规
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于7月9日公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查初步裁定，拟对进口自中国的纯电动汽车加征17%至36%的临时关税，预计7月底前生效。此举将显著影响比亚迪、上汽等中国车企对欧出口。建议企业立即启动原产地规则审查，评估在欧盟设厂或与当地企业合资的可行性，同时关注WTO争端解决程序进展。
focus.title_en: EU Proposes Provisional Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs; Chinese Firms Advised to Prepare Supply Chain Compliance
focus.summary_en: On July 9, the European Commission announced preliminary findings in its anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese EVs, proposing provisional tariffs of 17% to 36% on imports of battery electric vehicles from China, expected to take effect by end of July. This significantly impacts Chinese automakers like BYD and SAIC. Companies are advised to immediately review rules of origin, assess feasibility of EU-based manufacturing or joint ventures, and monitor WTO dispute resolution developments.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁院裁决：中资企业因不可抗力条款不完善被判违约，赔偿外方2300万美元
case.summary: 在SIAC仲裁案ARB-2025-089中，某中国工程公司因海外项目遭遇当地政局动荡，援引合同不可抗力条款主张免责，但仲裁庭认定其条款未明确列举政治事件且未及时通知，裁定公司违约并赔偿外方2300万美元。此案警示出海企业：不可抗力条款应具体化，并严格履行通知义务。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁院 · 2026年6月裁决
case.title_en: SIAC Ruling: Chinese Firm Found in Breach Due to Inadequate Force Majeure Clause, Ordered to Pay US$23 Million
case.summary_en: In SIAC arbitration case ARB-2025-089, a Chinese engineering company invoked a force majeure clause to excuse performance after political unrest in the host country. The tribunal held the clause did not explicitly cover political events and the company failed to provide timely notice, ruling it in breach and awarding US$23 million in damages. This case underscores the need for specific force majeure clauses and strict compliance with notice requirements.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre · Award dated June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规出台，简化企业合规流程
policy.summary: 广东省网信办联合港澳相关部门于7月8日发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动便利化管理办法》，对区内企业实施“白名单”管理，符合条件的企业在跨境传输个人及重要数据时，可免于单独安全评估，仅需备案。此举将降低企业合规成本，促进大湾区金融、医疗、科技等领域的跨境协作。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07.08
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area Simplify Compliance for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: On July 8, the Guangdong Cyberspace Administration, together with Hong Kong and Macau authorities, issued the 'Measures for Facilitating Cross-Border Data Flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area,' introducing a 'white list' mechanism. Eligible enterprises can transfer personal and important data across borders without separate security assessments, only requiring filing. This reduces compliance burdens and promotes cross-border collaboration in finance, healthcare, and technology.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体出口管制再升级，中国企业应建立“双供应链”应对策略
analysis.summary: 美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）拟于7月底扩大对华半导体设备及EDA软件的出口管制，新增限制14nm以下制程相关物项。秦林蒿律师研判：建议中企立即梳理供应链中受EAR管辖的物项，加速国产替代验证，同时通过海外子公司申请许可证或寻求第三国转口路径，但需警惕“最小比例”规则和最终用户审查风险。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: US Semiconductor Export Controls Tighten; Chinese Firms Should Adopt 'Dual Supply Chain' Strategy
analysis.summary_en: The US BIS plans to expand export controls on semiconductor equipment and EDA software to China by end of July, adding items related to sub-14nm processes. Attorney Qin advises: companies should immediately audit EAR-controlled items in their supply chains, accelerate domestic substitution validation, and consider applying for licenses through overseas subsidiaries or exploring third-country transshipment routes, while remaining vigilant against the 'de minimis' rule and end-user scrutiny.
